# opnsense_bind_secondary_domain (Data Source)

Zones BIND copies from another server (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ Secondary Zones**, plugin `os-bind`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND secondary zone.

### Read-Only

- `allownotifysecondary` (Set of String) A list of allowed IP addresses to receive notifies from (in addition to the primary server.).
- `allowquery` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which client are allowed to query this zone.
- `allowtransfer` (Set of String) Define the ACLs where you allow which server can retrieve this zone.
- `domainname` (String) Set the name for this zone. Both forward and reverse zones may be specified, i.e. example.com or 0.168.192.in-addr.arpa.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable this zone.
- `primaryip` (Set of String) Set the IP address of primary server.
- `transferkey` (String, Sensitive) The TSIG key used to transfer domain data from the master server in Base64 encoding.
- `transferkeyalgo` (String) Set the authentication algorithm for the TSIG key used to transfer domain data from the primary server. One of `hmac-sha512`, `hmac-sha384`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha224`, `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-md5`.
- `transferkeyname` (String) The name of the TSIG key, which must match the value on the primary server.
